description: Create a dynamic QR code and short link for a PDF (menus, flyers, tickets). Host the PDF by passing `pdf_url` (a link Hovercode fetches) or `pdf_base64` (the file's base64 bytes). Returns a shareable short link plus a rendered QR. Because it's dynamic you can later swap the PDF without reprinting the code — always dynamic, no static option here. Counts toward the same workspace dynamic-code limit as create_qr_code (list_workspaces' `dynamic_qr_limit`); past that limit this call returns an error.

display_name.description: Internal name to find this code later.

domain.description: Custom short-link domain (list_workspaces shows the plan).

filename.description: Name for the stored file, e.g. 'menu.pdf'.

pdf_base64.description: Base64-encoded PDF bytes (data-URI prefix allowed), max 20 MB. Or use pdf_url.

pdf_url.description: URL of a PDF to fetch and host. Use this or pdf_base64.

tags.description: Labels to attach (created if new) so you can find these later — list_qr_codes and list_short_links search by tag.

workspace.description: Workspace id. Optional when the account has one workspace; use list_workspaces to resolve otherwise.

name: create_pdf_qr

error.description: Present only when the tool failed (isError): cause, retryable, message.

png.description: PNG URL once rendered; null until then (use download_qr).

qr_data.description: Encoded data: the destination URL for URL codes.

shortlink_url.description: Tracked short URL a dynamic code points at; null for static codes.
